units.source_text: 休息三个月之后，在伊东续弈的头一天，

en.t: After a three-month recess, on the day before play was to resume in Ito,

units.source_text: 大竹七段下最初一手，费了两百一十一分钟，

en.t: Otake 7-dan took 211 minutes to make his first move,

units.source_text: 即经过三个半小时的长考，使工作人员也为之瞠目。

en.t: a three-and-a-half-hour deliberation that left even the staff staring in astonishment.

units.source_text: 从上午十时半开始思考，其中有一小时午饭休息。

en.t: He had begun thinking at 10:30 in the morning, with a one-hour lunch break in between.

units.source_text: 秋阳西斜，棋盘上方亮起了电灯。

en.t: The autumn sun slanted westward, and an electric light came on above the Go board.

units.source_text: 差二十分三点，好不容易才下出黑101。

en.t: At twenty minutes to three, Black 101 was finally played.
